metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the C++20 LAS 1.4 inspector/renderer in [output/main.cpp](/workspace/output/main.cpp) with build config at [output/CMakeLists.txt](/workspace/output/CMakeLists.txt).

Verified with:

```sh
cd /workspace/output
cmake -B build && cmake --build build
```

It supports inspect/render JSON requests, LAS 1.4 header/VLR/EVLR validation, CRS records, point formats 0–10, waveform metadata/data, and Extra Bytes metadata.

editorial.last_message: Completed the C++ LAS implementation; unchanged source scores 222/223 under LAS 2.0.5. Remaining failures concern undocumented Extra Bytes descriptor decoding.
editorial.notes:
Tests-only LAS 2.0.5 regrade of the unchanged preserved gpt-5.6-terra Max C++ source. The previous 2.0.4 publication scored 218/223; the corrected suite scores 222/223 with no skips or errors. All 219 unaffected node identities and outcomes are identical, and the four renamed zero-waveform cases pass. Their fixtures now retain valid file-level descriptors and storage, changing only the point's waveform association. Descriptor index zero is a per-point absence marker and does not unambiguously waive separately required file metadata. Any previous classification of metadata/storage-free zero-waveform rejection as a proven model defect is withdrawn. The old publication and prior audit chain are preserved in full. Unchanged observed failure families: undocumented Extra Bytes descriptor decoding. Exact failed nodes: test_vlrs.py::test_inspect_undocumented_extra_bytes_descriptor. Repeated format/action observations are not counts of independent implementation bugs. The original completion, source/transcript and accounting reviews remain applicable to the unchanged generation; their full historical editorial text remains in the linked prior publication. Root and an independent reviewer checked the revised public-contract interpretation, focused reference/mutation controls, source preservation and per-case comparison.  Original raw result/source hashes, generation metadata, input/output/cache/reasoning token totals and recorded cost are retained. Current usage is independently reparsed from preserved events. The regrade makes no new model calls and adds no generation cost. Reasoning remains an output subset. Any separate tool-count recovery is explicitly linked and preserves its historical evidence.

Run conditions: apps available but no external tool invocation observed.
